programs.name: Phi Phi Islands, Maya Bay & Bamboo Island
programs.route: Maya Bay · Pileh Lagoon · Phi Phi Leh · Viking Cave · Monkey Beach · Phi Phi Don · Bamboo Island
programs.desc: One-day speedboat tour from Krabi. Visit famous Maya Bay, swim at Pileh Lagoon, snorkel around Phi Phi Leh, see Viking Cave and Monkey Beach from the boat, enjoy a Thai buffet lunch on Phi Phi Don, and relax on Bamboo Island.

programs.name: Krabi 4 Islands Tour by Speedboat
programs.route: Phra Nang Cave Beach · Thale Waek · Chicken Island · Poda Island
programs.desc: Explore crystal-clear waters, white sandy beaches, and Krabi’s iconic limestone islands by speedboat — Phra Nang Cave Beach, Thale Waek (Separated Sea), Chicken Island, and Poda Island.
programs.galleryCaption: Phra Nang Cave Beach · Separated Sea · Chicken Island · Poda Island

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up & check-in
itinerary.text: Pick-up from your hotel (approximately 08:00–09:00 AM) and transfer to the pier for check-in. Board the speedboat and depart for the 4 Islands Tour

itinerary.title: Phra Nang Cave Beach
itinerary.text: Discover a beautiful beach surrounded by towering limestone cliffs. Visit the cave shrine, relax on the sand, and capture stunning coastal views

itinerary.title: Thale Waek — The Separated Sea
itinerary.text: At low tide, a white sandbar connects Tup Island, Mor Island, and Chicken Island. Walk between the islands and enjoy this remarkable natural attraction, depending on sea levels

itinerary.title: Chicken Island
itinerary.text: Admire the famous chicken-shaped limestone rock formation. Enjoy snorkeling in shallow waters and spotting colorful marine life

itinerary.title: Poda Island
itinerary.text: Relax on a white sandy beach, swim in clear water, and take photos with the striking Koh Tang Ming rock formation in the background

deposit.note: Cash deposit 3,000 THB, or cash/credit card hold 5,000 THB depending on rental terms.

conditions: Renters must present a valid ID card or passport and a valid driving licence.
Renters must pay the required security deposit.
Insurance is included. The renter is responsible for accident damage up to 10,000 THB; amounts exceeding this may not be covered — please confirm with the rental provider.
The vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level as at pickup.
Vehicles may be used within Krabi Province only. Travel to Phang Nga or Phuket is not permitted.
notes: Return at Krabi Airport: additional 300 THB.
The Toyota Yaris ATIV is listed at 1,100 THB beside the vehicle photo, but 1,000 THB in a lower brochure price table — please confirm the correct rate before booking.
